label: October 12–18
title: “The Redeemer Shall Come to Zion” —  Isaiah 58

items.text: Jesus Christ is the Anointed One who came to 'heal the brokenhearted' and 'preach deliverance to the captives.' His prophecies in Isaiah are being fulfilled, and He continues to heal those who come unto Him, offering a glorious future as He creates new heavens and a new earth.

Fasting, when understood through the Lord’s teachings, becomes a blessing, not a burden. It has the power to 'loose the bands of wickedness' and 'break every yoke,' bringing spiritual power and blessing to both the individual and those in need.

When we choose to 'delight thyself in the Lord' on His holy day, rather than pursuing our own pleasures, the Sabbath becomes a source of profound joy. Honoring the Lord’s day brings blessings and spiritual refreshment.

The prophecies in Isaiah reveal the Lord’s lovingkindnesses, highlighting His role as an intercessor who overcomes iniquity. As we study these passages, we can better understand the Savior’s mission and His profound love for His people.
Jesus Christ declared Himself as the Messiah, quoting Isaiah to teach the people. He has blessed us and others by giving 'beauty for ashes,' fulfilling the Savior's mission to comfort and redeem.

Reading Isaiah opens our eyes to the Lord’s divine plan. It reveals what He has already done for His people, what He is doing in our lives now, and the glorious future He has promised, including the creation of new heavens and earth.

The Savior continues to fulfill the prophecies of Isaiah in our day. He offers healing to the brokenhearted and deliverance to those who are captive, preparing us for a future where righteousness springs forth before all nations.

Understanding the Lord’s perspective on fasting transforms it from a mere abstinence to a powerful tool. It empowers us to break spiritual chains and extend blessings to others, fulfilling the Lord’s expectation of true charity.
Honoring the Sabbath day as a delight brings spiritual rejuvenation. When we turn from our own desires to focus on the Lord, we experience the joy and peace He intends for His holy day.

Isaiah’s prophecies illuminate the Savior’s mission as our Redeemer and intercessor. He overcomes the sins and iniquities that separate us from God, offering His lovingkindnesses and redemption to all who will come unto Him.
